name: Clan Personalities
description: Living-world social sim: assigns personas (Peaceful, Neutral, Altruistic, Aggressive, Player-Killing) to living clans whose phantom members chatter, start drama and retaliate in chat, remembering what was said. Every word comes from the pack's FPC brain, composed on its own executor so the game's timers never wait; optional Phase 2 field duels ship behind the Phase2 switch (off by default).
author: thiag
